news.headline: Wildfires in France: French farmers provide water tankers to help fight fire
news.summary: "Civilian farmers are trying to help firefighters by bringing in tankers of water to keep their hoses running," FRANCE 24 reporter Luke Shrago said, reporting from Lège-Cap-Ferret, where one of the largest forest fires France has seen since WWII is still blazing.

news.headline: Germany: Berlin Pride attack believed to be an act of Islamic extremist terror
news.summary: German investigators on Sunday searched for a man who allegedly drove a van into a crowd near Berlin's Pride festival, killing one person and injuring many others, before allegedly stabbing additional people with a machete in what authorities believe was an Islamist extremist terror attack.
